indexText: Established as a national park Oct. 1, 1890
claim: Yosemite National Park: Established as a national park Oct. 1, 1890. The President in office that day was Benjamin Harrison.
source: The National Parks: Index 2012–2016 (National Park Service), PDF page 38

claim: Yosemite National Park: El Portal site authorized Sept. 2, 1958. This was an act of Congress, approved (signed) that day. The President in office that day was Dwight D. Eisenhower.
source: The National Parks: Index 2012–2016 (National Park Service), PDF page 38

claim: Zion National Park: Authorized March 30, 2009. This was an act of Congress, approved (signed) that day. The President in office that day was Barack Obama.
source: The National Parks: Index 2012–2016 (National Park Service), PDF page 140
